raw_text: This LoC video going viral is suspicious. I've seen similar footage from 2019 Balakot era. The terrain and lighting look identical to videos from February 2019. Has anyone run a reverse image search? Also, no credible defence journalist or ISPR/Indian Army PRO has confirmed any new shelling. This looks like recycled content.
clean_text: Reddit user questions viral LoC video. Notes similarity to 2019 Balakot footage. No defence journalist or official source confirms new shelling. Suspected recycled content.
